text:
marta: Kickoff: Starter Sprint + Hacknight — target next Tue.
We're shipping: launch post (OSS refapp), 2 tutorials (quickstart + deep-dive), benchmark narrative, 45m webinar, and inbound lead funnel. Need owners & routing.
kevin: Timeline?
marta: Timeline: prep week (assets + code samples), dry-run hacknight Wed, webinar Thu, post on Fri. Non-negotiable: benchmark data and refapp demo by Wed EOD.
jamie: Benchmark story — who owns metrics & writeup?
marta: Jamie to own benchmark narrative. Focus on latency vs cost tradeoffs, routing policy examples, and sample config for Dedicated vs Hosted.
eli: For webinar signups, what's the routing? want to capture org size + primary use case.
marta: Yes. Form fields: name, email, org, use-case, infra (cloud/on-prem). Route rules in short: MQL if org size >50 or use-case = platform.
eli: Can we add tags for 'eval' vs 'prod' so sales can prioritize?
marta: Good call. Add 'intent:eval' and 'intent:prod' tags.
tess: I'll take the OSS launch post + refapp PR checklist. Assigning to myself for content + repo README updates.
jamie: I'll run the perf runs. Need machines: 4x A40 equiv for consistency. Can we pin a bench window?
marta: Bench window = Tue 02:00–08:00 UTC. Keep runs repeatable and commit the seed scripts.
deploy-bot: staging demo deployed: https://staging.redwood.dev/refapp (build 2026.3.14)
kevin: Webinar host + MC?
marta: Kevin to MC. Eli to handle demo walkthrough. Jamie to present benchmark.
eli: For inbound routing, here's a simple rule set:
```
if form.org_size >= 50 -> tag:MQL -> assign:enterprise-queue
elif form.intent == 'prod' -> tag:high-intent -> assign:solutions-team
else -> nurture:community-drip
```
kevin: Can we automate routing via HubSpot webhooks?
eli: Yes — I'll wire webhooks and add a fallback email to marketing@redwood.dev
tess: PR checklist: README, quickstart gifs, 2-step CI to run tiny smoke bench, license header, CODE_OF_CONDUCT.
jamie: I'll upload raw bench logs + plots to the shared drive after runs.
marta: Next steps: owners - jamie (bench), tess (refapp + post), kevin (webinar host + comms), eli (routing/webhooks). I'll assemble the comms doc and share for approvals by EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:
